expected.tolerance_basis: No peer-reviewed or methodologically documented external measurement of putter-face COR was located (search covered Penner 2002, Holmes 1991, Drane et al. 2014, and Quintic/Hurrion practitioner materials). USGA/R&A equipment rules explicitly exempt putters from the spring-like-effect/COR limit that caps driver and iron faces at COR<=0.822+/-0.008 (Pendulum Test Protocol), so there is no regulatory ceiling to borrow either. UD's GROUND_RESTITUTION=0.78 and the Gemini vendor source's StrokeParameters.cor (0.79/0.820, internally inconsistent between its own dataclass default and a hardcoded impact-path value) are both uncited internal engineering assumptions, not externally measured constants.
